# `aitbc node island join`

Join an existing island by ID, name, and chain.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc node island join [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--island-id` | text | — | yes | The Island id. |
| `--island-name` | text | — | yes | The Island name. |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | yes | The Chain id. |
| `--hub` | text | `hub.aitbc.invalid` | no | Hub domain name to connect to |
| `--is-hub` | flag | `false` | no | Register this node as a hub for the island |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | RPC base URL for the join request (defaults to config.blockchain_rpc_url) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc node island join --island-id <island_id> --island-name <island_name> --chain-id <chain_id>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc node island join --island-id <island_id> --island-name <island_name> --chain-id <chain_id> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
